claims.predicate: ACCEPT-D-60 passes iff, at the measured revision, the amulets entry cites exactly the 43 S-ids it cites at lane base 9c82a6eb plus S648, S649, S650 and S651, each new id on exactly one line that is not a base line, and none of S602, S616, S623, S643; carries none of the four frozen over-reach phrases; each new id is one Registry row, status mined, tier A or B, used-by the entry, whose teaches opens `supersedes <mapped id> —` and is not the mapped row's teaches, which carries none of the four frozen phrases, and whose first URL names the same page as the mapped row's first URL, whose quote locates in its pinned committed capture and shares at least 6 content words with the entry line citing it; the entry's sha256 equals the entry_sha256 in the packet key whose hash was committed before the support call; and every one of the 47 cited ids is SUPPORTED by 2 distinct qualified, blind declared support seats whose own transcript fetched the row's page, with no NOT-SUPPORTED from any declared seat.
claims.receipt_label: ACCEPT-D-60: PASS|FAIL (last stdout line; exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 input error)
claims.before: ACCEPT-D-60: FAIL at the claim base (SET, LINES, ROWS, PINNED, JUDGED, SUPPORT FAIL; OLDWORD PASS)
claims.kill_rule: One NOT-SUPPORTED verdict on any of the 47 cited ids from any declared seat, an id with fewer than 2 counted SUPPORTED seats, or any other leg FAIL, fails the claim. The judged object is the entry whose sha256 the packet key records; after the support task call no byte of the entry, of SOURCES rows S600-S651 or of the captures changes before the final measure. A miss is reported, never amended, narrowed or re-scaled; no row or line is removed after a verdict.
claims.fetch_rule: FETCH-60: no ACCEPT-D-60 leg fetches over the network. PINNED reads committed captures only. A support reviewer opens each page by its listed live URL or its listed Wayback capture; a page the reviewer cannot open by any listed URL is answered NOT-SUPPORTED (reason: unreachable), which fails the claim. This treatment is frozen here and never relaxed.
review_only: whether each repaired sentence is the best wording a scholar would choose

PROVENANCE beyond the leg: that each session file ~/.omp/agent/sessions/*/*/KotodamaR60A3/KotodamaR60A3.<Seat>.jsonl is the one omp wrote for that dispatched seat (the closure compares it with history://KotodamaR60A3.<Seat>); the leg itself requires each committed transcript to be a byte copy of that session file
CONFINED beyond the leg: that no seat reached lane or key bytes through an encoding the CONFINE_DENY tokens do not name (the closure reads the committed transcripts)
planted-rows.sha256 committed before the first data seat; planted-key.sha256 committed before the support task call (git log of both)
controls_before_data: do-nothing: the claim base, and the base plus records only
junk: lines and rows citing S648-S651 with junk text, junk captures, fabricated support files
all-false and all-true reviewers (every verdict NOT-SUPPORTED; every verdict SUPPORTED)
no-reader: reports without packets or transcripts; a transcript with no fetch of the row's page
shortcut keyed on ids or labels: a reviewer keyed on packet labels or on the lane's committed registry/entry (reads the lane instead of the pages)
post-verdict narrowing (the round-59 shape): drop rows or lines after the verdicts
old wording: the round-59 rejected sentences restored with the new ids
server echo / self-made capture: a capture or URL that echoes the quote

Revision 2 (attempt 2, KotodamaR60A2, before its control wave and before any data seat; the predicate sentence is unchanged): (a) seat ids and session paths move to KotodamaR60A2.<Seat> because attempt 1's seats died with its process and attempt 2 dispatches the support seats; (b) L1 review of the revision-1 counter against the round-59 narrowing shape: a NOT-SUPPORTED was counted only while its block still matched the landed text and its id was still cited, so a reword or a re-key after the verdicts could drop a rejection -> every NOT-SUPPORTED on a label the key maps to an S-id fails SUPPORT, and a seat counts only when BOUND (its packet names the key's entry_sha256 and occurs byte-for-byte in its own dispatched task); the planted-rows sha256 is also frozen inside the counter; (c) echo/self-made capture URLs: a row's later URLs and the pinned capture URL must be its first URL or Wayback captures of that same page. Attempt 1 drafted (b) and (c) as uncommitted scratch after its own control seats; attempt 2 cites none of those seats or files and re-attacks the same shapes in its own control wave. Data seats are exactly the SupportA60..SupportP60 reviewer seats; build-wave seats (drafting, pre-freeze wording audits, captures) and control seats score nothing under ACCEPT-D-60.
